agent.specialty: SubAgent 7 dated technology intelligence, alternatives and monitoring

analytical_question: Which dated landscape alternatives and signals matter for the defined application and organization, and what should change the next review?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-18, agentic capability is uneven and application-specific. L1/L2 describe native BI assistance and mutable experience-specific prerequisites, not chart-validation guarantees; L1 now flags retirement of some standalone/app surfaces while report-scoped use is unaffected by that notice. Exact retirement dates remain unverified. L3 illustrates deterministic integrity checks, and L5 is an integration complement rather than permission. L4 is archival chart-reasoning research, not current model leadership. L6 is inactive historical software-task measurement, not autonomous runtime or chart accuracy. L7 is voluntary guidance, not binding law. L8 is a dated analyst interpretation, not our maturity score or a matching penetration statistic. Current exact-task adoption, investment trends, total cost and comparative performance are UNKNOWN. No single score, current vendor ranking or adoption forecast is justified.
application_finding: For the stipulated fixed-field arithmetic/period/unit/denominator task, the strongest conventional alternative is the existing validated deterministic rule plus human exception handling. Manual checking remains fallback. Model drafting, native summaries and adaptive agents are partial/optional approaches, not needed merely to repeat a covered check. L3 illustrates rule mechanisms, not this firm’s installed software; the rule-validity premise comes from the constructed case. Source tables, rule versions and exception logs are complements. Reopen the agent comparison only for documented material exceptions or rule-maintenance burdens that the baseline cannot adequately handle.
organization_specific_finding: KEEP_BASELINE: preserve the stipulated validated rule and human exceptions. COMPARE_IF_AUTHORIZED is not currently justified by a demonstrated residual need. WATCH: recurring material exceptions/maintenance cost, not generic model releases. NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE: any incremental agent benefit; A’s external-route prohibition is unchanged by a simpler task. Capability/adoption/investment headlines are BACKGROUND; incumbent coverage and alternative fit are DECISION_RELEVANT; complement/rule lineage and governance scope remain relevant; complete cost WATCH; native ecosystem and protocol changes WATCH only if exceptions create a real option. Most consequential development would be an evidenced baseline gap. Its emergence could reopen comparator design but would not grant permission.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Native platforms could reduce custom integration work if genuinely available and permitted; this remains a candidate hypothesis, not proof of chart accuracy.
An agent might add value to residual interpretive work that validated fixed rules cannot cover. Local measured advantage is unknown.
Same-assistant qualitative prompt runs and structural checks are not independent reliability tests or a company pilot.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the attributed documentation/comparison approach; low confidence in local quality, complete cost, current task diffusion or a model/vendor choice. Source retrieval does not refresh a historical observation.
value_opportunity_implication: Investigate quality-adjusted full effort at a matched task volume. No savings, total-cost amount or ROI is established by feature announcements or an existing licence.
risk_governance_implication: Landscape intelligence never grants data/tool permission, legal certification or release authority. Preserve human sign-off and the relevant upstream stage limits.
recommendation_management_implication: Keep the validated deterministic rule for the stated task. Request evidence of a residual problem before spending on agent investigation. Preserve A’s permission boundary; no broad rejection of all chart agents follows.
change_monitoring_triggers: Owner: proposed rule/control owner | Cadence: each reporting cycle and schema change | Signal/evidence: versioned exception log showing recurring material failures or full maintenance burden beyond the validated rule scope | Action: reopen residual-task comparison with Adoption, not add an agent to an already covered task.

Owner: proposed BI/security steward | Cadence: before any data/tool change and immediately on control loss | Signal/evidence: tested rule/source lineage and actual permitted route | Action: retain/recover deterministic baseline; do not borrow permission from another context.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: ASK NOW, BI/data steward: exact platform/feature/version and permitted data/tool route; this changes eligible comparisons, not intrinsic technology maturity.
ASK NOW, reporting/security owners: accepted owner/cover and protected effort for the proposed activity. Until supplied do not infer execution readiness.
BEFORE a benefit claim: pre-agreed task/quality criteria, reference outcomes, failures, support/correction workload and comparable baseline evidence.
